description.value: False Bay Provisions is a general store, bakery, and café that has served the remote community of Lasqueti Island since 2015, offering organic and international groceries, fresh-baked bread and pastries, soups, sandwiches, and meals to go. Lasqueti is accessible only by foot-passenger ferry — no vehicle ferry exists — making this the island's primary provisioning stop for cyclists exploring on foot or by bike. The shop also stocks local arts, crafts, books, and seasonal produce, reflecting the self-sufficient character of island life.
